*Brief description of changes, architectural enhancements, or documentation updates.*
*(وصف موجز للتغييرات أو التحسينات المعمارية أو تحديثات التوثيق).*

### 🏷️ Type of Change / نوع التعديل

- [ ] 🎨 Design System & Token Specifications (`style`)

### 🛡️ Security & Quality Checklist / قائمة التحقق الأمنية والجودة
*Please confirm adherence to repository governance rules:*
- [ ] **NO PROPRIETARY CODE:** No PHP, JS, or CSS source code from the theme is exposed.
- [ ] **NO SECRETS:** Verified zero API keys, passwords, credentials, or private server IPs.
- [ ] **BILINGUAL PARITY:** Changes are reflected in both English and Arabic files.
- [ ] **TESTS VALIDATED:** Automated testing scripts and static security audits pass with 0 errors.
